# Harrow & Thread

> Bespoke handmade rugs, wall hangings and wall-to-wall carpets, each designed for one room and never made twice. A UK business serving clients in the United Kingdom, Europe and the United States.

## Key facts

- Every commission is priced individually in a written proposal, before any deposit. There are no public prices.
- Materials: wool, pure silk, bamboo silk or flatweave. Pile heights: 6mm, 12mm or 20mm. Design tiers: plain, geometric or pictorial.
- Colour is matched to a reference from the ARS 1,400-colour system.
- Sizes: rugs and wall-to-wall carpets up to 15m × 10m; wall hangings from 1.5m² up to about 6m × 3m.
- Lead time: about six to seven weeks from sign-off to dispatch for a straightforward piece, then around two weeks for delivery; larger and more complex pieces take longer.
- A 50% deposit confirms the order and production begins; the balance is due before dispatch.
- Shipping is included and insured to the UK, Europe and the United States for most commissions. Pieces travel rolled.
- The designs shown on the site are design visualisations. Client pieces never appear on the website or in sales material.
- Contact is by the enquiry form or by email at meadow.mace@harrowandthread.com. Replies come within one working day.

- [Home](https://harrowandthread.com/): what Harrow & Thread makes, with a selection of designs.
- [Commissions](https://harrowandthread.com/commissions/): materials, pile heights, sizes, design tiers, colour and how a commission is priced.
- [Wall hangings](https://harrowandthread.com/wall-hangings/): how a handmade wall hanging hangs, its size limits and care.
- [Wall-to-wall carpets](https://harrowandthread.com/carpets/): supply-only fitted carpets, measuring, charged area and pattern trimming.
- [Materials](https://harrowandthread.com/materials/): how pieces are made (hand-tufted, hand-knotted in five grades, flatweave) and the fibres (New Zealand wool, pure silk, bamboo silk, lyocell).
- [Process](https://harrowandthread.com/process/): each step from first enquiry to delivery and the design assigned to the client.
- [Designs](https://harrowandthread.com/designs/): every design visualisation, with room, size, material and colour.
- [FAQ](https://harrowandthread.com/faq/): pricing, sizes, materials, lead times, shipping, customs and returns.
- [Care](https://harrowandthread.com/care/): looking after a handmade rug, carpet or wall hanging.
- [Trade](https://harrowandthread.com/trade/): specification support for interior designers, architects and developers.
- [Enquire](https://harrowandthread.com/enquire/): start a commission.
- [Terms](https://harrowandthread.com/terms/) and [Privacy](https://harrowandthread.com/privacy/).
